text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet is meticulously inspecting her racing outfit...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: You're being even more thorough than usual.
You're being even more thorough than usual, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously! The race is coming up soon,
so you have to double-check things with your own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
These are clothes meant for me to wear,
so I won't overlook even a single micron of fraying...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still—
Haa... It really is lovely no matter how many times I see it...
choice_data_list: Why not double-check how it feels to wear, too?
Why not double-check how it feels to wear, too?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I suppose? There are some things
you won't know until you actually try it on, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you've got it wrong!? It's not that I want to wear it,
I'm just making sure!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—C-Come on!
I'm changing, so get outside already!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! It really feels amazing every time I put it on!
I can truly feel the pride of an Umamusume competing in GⅠ races!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Even outside of races,
I just can't help wanting to wear it~♪"
choice_data_list: Didn't you just want an excuse to wear it...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Th-Th-That's not true at all!
That's not what I meant just now!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Besides, aren't you the one
who just wanted to see me wear it!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wait, what kind of weird question am I asking—
choice_data_list: I thought you actually wanted to show me how it looks on you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! Are you being serious right now?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I, I see............
You were... actually for real... Huh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...And?
What are your thoughts after seeing it up close in person?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh! Y-you listen here!!
That part of you is really――――
She got scolded while still wearing her racing outfit, but she didn't seem all that unhappy about it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? A-As if! No way in hell!
Don't get the wrong idea!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! Of course it looks good on me!
You're not going to distract me with that!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Geez, unless you specifically ask for it,
I am NEVER wearing this in front of you again!
I decided against bringing up whether she'd actually wear it if asked.
